items.context: @WatcherGuru (4.929.987 seguidores), en inglés: "JUST IN: Bitcoin reclaims $61,000 and ETH reclaims $1,715", con imagen. Post de ~5 min con 115 likes, 34 respuestas y 46859 vistas. Tema: debate del precio de BTC; ángulo: Market Temperature de 99,29 a 0,67 en 364 días y recuperación tras máximos (Drawdown Atlas 2013: 210 vs 1.177 días).
items.suggested_text:
A bounce back to $61K feels good, but the more useful read is where price sits in the cycle, not the round number.

My Market Temperature index blends four inputs at 25% each: MVRV, price vs the 200-week average, distance from the all-time high and volatility-adjusted 90-day momentum. It went from 99.29 to 0.67 in 364 days, a full swing from euphoria to frost in about a year.

A cold reading describes where the market is, not when it turns. In 2013 one peak was recovered in 210 days and the other took 1,177. Reclaiming a level is the headline; whether those cold readings start warming up is the quieter part of the story.
